notes.title: Reigns: Three Kingdoms - Update #2 - Achievements Included
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
First of all, thank you for your patience and support since Reigns: Three Kingdoms launched earlier in the year. Your reports and feedback have been invaluable, helping us improve the game and allowing us to focus on some of the most requested features and QOL changes in this latest update.

Reigns: Three Kingdoms Update #2 comes with Achievement support. Unlock 16 of them on your quest to unite China. Also included is a handful of quality of life improvements like tweaked menu navigation with KB/M and controller configurations, and more. 

Previously reported issues with the game logic have been addressed in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2437040/announcements/detail/3966049540921763018]January 19 update[/url], but please let us know if you experience any similar issues again.

Happy Swiping,
Nerial

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/df531a043f76c752083222e4b9d9cdf77eafaacd.png[/img]

[h2]Reigns: Three Kingdoms Update #2 Changelog[/h2]

[b]NEW AND EXCITING[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlock 16 achievements on your quest to unite China.
[/list]
[b]Improved menu navigation[/b]
[list]
[*] Scroll wheel can now be used in the compendium
[*]  Smooth navigation of the user profile when using a controller
[*] Closing dropdowns using B doesn’t also perform the back action
[*] After previewing a card in the Hero Gallery, the position that the player scrolled to is retained
[*] When using arrow keys to scroll the compendium, the scroll bar follows the position correctly
[/list]
[b]Improved visual fidelity[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduction in pixelation on some cards and UI elements
[/list]

notes.title: Blast off with a new Reigns game coming to Steam
notes.content:
[h1]Get ready to rock and roll through space, Reigns Beyond is coming to Steam this spring![/h1]

Set a course to stardom in this sci-fi spin on the novel card-swiping game. You join an intergalactic indie rock band travelling to distant planets to host gigs of various sizes, all for fame and fortune. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663400/Reigns_Beyond/

Recruit alien band members, visit new places, manage your ship's resources and keep your crew happy while you cruise through the galaxy.

Oh and keep an eye out for some sharp-toothed "friends"...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/a01c44a64aa977c11873da081afd843eb6202685.gif[/img]

Weirder human and alien encounters, even weirder deaths, and exciting new gameplay that features the ever-amazing original soundtrack by Sam Webster. With 70 new characters and over 1700 cards, this is not the same Reigns royal courts you may be familiar with.

[previewyoutube=v3sMQgPG3Xc;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/df531a043f76c752083222e4b9d9cdf77eafaacd.png[/img]

notes.title: First patch and a thank you
notes.content:
A huge thank you to everyone who has played Reigns: Three Kingdoms and supported our PC release!

We've read all of the reactions and feedback we've gotten for the game and have worked hard on a small patch to fix some of the bugs that have been spotted. We truly appreciate the diligent reports the community have made and we've taken steps to give back to you all.

This post highlights the patch and other updates. For a full, detailed list of the patch notes please click the image below:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2437040/view/3966049540918553506][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/e0331302edfcb335c21076af3bff07ba2dd5e647.png[/img][/url]
[h3][b]New Feature[/b][/h3]

As with the previous Reigns games, we have included the button to reset game data!
All you need to do is press the "R" key for 5 seconds. Simple!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/fa9634296fc9334d630112050a448d71bef844f6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Cao Cao[/b][/h3]

As the saying goes, speak of the devil and the devil appears! This character has caused a bit of trouble throughout development and the Netflix release. He refused to stay dead!

We have, once again, fixed it so Cao Cao will remain dead once he has died and won't appear in future events past his death. We have also fixed other characters seemingly coming back from the dead. May their spirits finally rest.

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Free Wallpapers[/b][/h3]

We've made the beautiful backgrounds of the different areas you visit in Reigns: Three Kingdoms into digital wallpapers to download for personal use. 


[b][u][url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Iq6JdtJT36fVJckTcgkdUqygaJfwCuqg?usp=drive_link]Click here to download your favourite wallpaper[/url][/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/f6dfee33136c1c232330fcd457d0a12676245a36.png[/img]

[h3][b]Reigns Complete Set[/b][/h3]

Want to complete your Reigns experience? Save 25% on the entire Reignsverse on Steam so far in this Steam-exclusive bundle

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37837/Reigns_Complete_Set/

[h3][b]Future patches[/b][/h3]

We'll continue working with the community to ensure that bugs are reported and investigated. There are a couple of points of feedback that we are looking to implement, such as achievements, which we will add in a future patch.

While the game does run on Steam Deck, we are eagerly awaiting the results of the Steam Deck verification!

[h3][b]And Beyond[/b][/h3]

Once again, thank you to our dedicated Reigns fans! Reigns has come a long way since 2016 and it's not going anywhere anytime soon. We are still working on even more, and will have some rocking news to announce soon!

Happy Swiping,
Nerial
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/df531a043f76c752083222e4b9d9cdf77eafaacd.png[/img]

Voice your suggestions and feedback to us in the Steam Discussions and [url=https://discord.gg/Nerial]Discord[/url]!

If you come across any further issues or bugs, please consult the steps in this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2437040/discussions/0/7119694643865663479/]post[/url] and report on our [url=https://discord.gg/Nerial]Discord[/url] so we can investigate and get fixes out!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3749.3665
notes.content:
Thank you for the support of the PC launch for Reigns: Three Kingdoms.

We have launched this patch as quickly as possible to address bugs that have been reported by the diligent community.

[b]Patch Notes 1.3749.3665[/b]

[list]
[*] General stability improvements
[*] Fixed soft lock when being forced to leave Yangzhou by Sun Quan
[*] Fixed quests and events occurring after a key character has already permanently died
[*] Fixed Cao Cao returning from the dead, again
[*] Fixed audio settings ignoring master volume in certain edge cases
[*] Adjusted Qiao Sisters Quest to allow more time for completion
[*] [b]New Feature[/b] - You can now press the R key for 5 seconds to clear game data 
[/list]

We hope this patch resolves the soft lock that a lot of users reported. If you come across any further issues or bugs, please consult the steps in this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2437040/discussions/0/7119694643865663479/]post[/url] and report on our [url=https://discord.gg/Nerial]Discord[/url] so we can investigate and get fixes out!

Happy Swiping

notes.title: Reigns: Three Kingdoms is launching on January 11th
notes.content:
[h1]Reigns: Three Kingdoms is coming to Steam on January 11th![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772779/f2b93dcd8065ac86b3f17f89eb199c7cc3df2c5b.gif[/img]

The latest addition to the Reignsverse is the most tantalising one yet. Inspired by the beloved epic, [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i], you'll take on the challenges found in the heart of the Han Dynasty. It’ll be up to you to unite the 13 regions and forge a path through decisive decision-making.

With unique characters, storylines, and quests to discover; this retelling of the stories found in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms will immerse you in diplomacy and military tactics with legendary characters.

The newest feature of the series is the card battle system. These battles incorporate the unique card-swiping mechanic, used throughout the Reignsverse, creating a new and effective way to add a fresh spin to the series. The characters you encounter will join your party and can be included in your drafts for each battle, you will also be able to challenge friends online!

[previewyoutube=jpYqrQoQm-M;full][/previewyoutube]

Eager to play already? You can still play the mobile version on Netflix!
